implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.handle_play_input maps arrow/WASD keys to settings.UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT and queues them via Snake.queue_direction.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Snake moves on the board each tick
implemented_requirements.evidence: Snake.update advances the head based on current direction and handles pending direction changes.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Food items appear on free cells and are re‑randomized after being eaten
implemented_requirements.evidence: Food.randomize_position selects a random cell not occupied by the snake; Game.update calls food.randomize_position after a collision with the head.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Snake grows when it eats food
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.update calls self.snake.grow() when head position matches food.position; Snake.grow increments grow_pending.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Game ends on self‑collision or boundary collision
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.update checks hit_wall and self.check_self_collision() and calls self.game_over().

implemented_requirements.requirement: Score is displayed based on food eaten
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.render_hud draws score and food_eaten using pygame fonts.
Game.handle_menu_input starts the game with "easy", "medium", or "hard"; settings.DIFFICULTY_LEVELS defines speed and multiplier.
Game.render calls render_board, draws food and snake each frame.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Main entry point launches the game loop
implemented_requirements.evidence: main.py calls game.run(), but Game class does not define a run() method.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Pause and game‑over screens are rendered
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.render references render_center_text and render_game_over, which are not defined.

critical_issues: Game class lacks a run() method that would contain the main loop; main.py will raise AttributeError.
render_center_text and render_game_over methods are called but never defined, causing runtime errors when entering paused or game‑over states.
Difficulty speed settings are never used to control the tick rate, so difficulty does not affect gameplay speed.
Menu rendering (render_menu) is referenced but not implemented, leaving the initial state unusable.
judge.summary: The code implements most core snake mechanics—directional control, movement, food spawning, growth, collision detection, scoring, and difficulty selection—but it is missing the essential game loop and several rendering helpers. Because of these gaps the program would not start or run correctly, resulting in a failing verdict.
